notes.title: NBA 2K26 review
notes.notes:
I regularly go against my best consumer instincts and check out the yearly iterations of sports games. It’s not something I’d likely be doing without some Steam press account magic letting me dodge the yearly cash sacrifice for a game that usually shares a huge chunk of DNA with its direct predecessor; a sense of deja vu is inevitable, unless you’ve been sensible enough to either let a few years pass or wait until you’ve spotted a new feature that piques your interest.

With NBA 2K26, there was one such addition in my mind. As someone who’s been keen to see 2K’s ball-to-basket series get rid of the invisible wall it’d put up between its simulations of men’s and women’s basketball for a good few years, the first-time addition of WNBA players to one of the marquee male-dominted modes caught my attention. Granted, it was MyTeam, the depressing pit in which you fork over either real money or fake money - acquired across hours of grinding - to buy trading cards that may or may not be dished out via something resembling a slot machine.

notes.title: NBA 2K26: Season 1 Courtside Report
notes.notes: [previewyoutube="fedQaUGzlNA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/beef98107715688b8ced4d2603c0db1c59a8d667.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Decorated in gold he shines under pressure, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander is a smooth operator and his skill is beyond measure.[/p][p][/p][p]The year of Shai is officially here; the reigning NBA Finals MVP and regular season MVP was born for the spotlight, commanding the postseason and the cover of [i]NBA 2K26[/i] in style. Season 1 captures the essence of SGA’s championship pedigree and effortless swagger, on and off the court.[/p][p][/p][p]Drop into The City* and experience a thriving hub of electrifying competition, with a more accessible layout and greater emphasis on hoops. Compete in MyCAREER and MyTEAM to accrue XP and earn all-new rewards, including consumables, VC, and fresh cosmetics to showcase your personality.[/p][p][/p][p]Begin your pursuit of greatness during Season 1 of [i]NBA 2K26[/i], and embark on your journey to join SGA in the pantheon of champions.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]MyCAREER[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]How will your MyCAREER be defined? As you progress through your NBA career and begin filling out your trophy case, you’ll earn XP and, in turn, level up the Season rewards ladder. Every Season of [i]NBA 2K26[/i], you can climb from Level 1 to Level 40 and unlock a trove of thematic items, ranging from Badge Perks, bundles, and MyPLAYER skins, to Cap Breakers and more![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Get Animated with Mascot Skins[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]In honor of [i]NBA 2K26[/i] cover athlete and Season 1’s featured hero Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, show your Oklahoma City Thunder team spirit with the Level 19 ‘Rumble the Bison’ mascot reward. Equip your MyPLAYER with this skin and charge through the lane as you lock horns with the competition, then get animated with Season 1 Teammotes. For the first time in [i]NBA 2K[/i] history, [i]NBA 2K26[/i] will feature a whole new library of Teammotes all year long. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/655fc8c627e7c65cb9bfe362e9b460b7a39d847c.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Level Up with New Rewards[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Ahead of the upcoming NBA regular season, set your sights on reaching Level 40 to claim the highlighted items below, and more:[/p][list][*][p]Level 5 - Boosted REC Elbow Band (5% REP Bonus)[/p][/*][*][p]Level 7 - Shaquille O’Neal MyCOURT Mural[/p][/*][*][p]Level 11 - Los Angeles Lakers MyCOURT Floor[/p][/*][*][p]Level 15 - Tier 1 ‘Clutch Gene’ Badge Perk[/p][/*][*][p]Level 19 - ‘Rumble the Bison’ Oklahoma City Thunder Mascot[/p][/*][*][p]Level 32 - Animated Mohawk Hairstyle[/p][/*][*][p]Level 35 - Tier 1 ‘Max +2’ Badge Perk[/p][/*][*][p]Level 37 - Beachside Bundle[/p][/*][*][p]Level 39 - Biohazard Suit[/p][/*][*][p]Level 40 - +1 Cap Breaker[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/2b3631e6b50a8d1c2f42d9d97a4d4ec4a356fa0a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Remember, you can earn XP from playing MyCAREER [i]and[/i] MyTEAM thanks to cross-progression, making it easier to climb the Season rewards ladder. Be on the lookout for 2XP events in The City to help expedite your progression—more information to come![/p][p][/p][h1][b]MyTEAM[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]For the first time in [i]NBA 2K[/i] history, you can collect and compete with NBA and WNBA players in MyTEAM. All WNBA Player Cards have been fully integrated, meaning players will experience balanced and consistent gameplay regardless of who’s on the court. It also means there’s an abundance of new rewards and cards to earn in [i]NBA 2K26[/i]![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Level 1 Ruby Kelsey Plum[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]To celebrate the start of the NBA-WNBA crossover in MyTEAM, get your collection started with the Trendsetter rewards, featuring Level 1 Ruby Kelsey Plum card, 3x Promo Packs, and a 120 MIN 2XP Coin. The two-time WNBA Champion, former Sixth Woman of the Year, and four-time All-Star has a knack for scoring and facilitating the offense. Let the 2017 No. 1 overall pick orchestrate your lineup in 3v3 or 5v5 game modes.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/c831bcf5e1a7a214cc137292b5b8d60cdb6c9fa0.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Level 10 Amethyst Steven Adams [/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Widely regarded as one of toughest players in the NBA, this New Zealand native brings the thunder from down under every time he crashes the glass. Bolster your paint presence with Level 10 Amethyst Steven Adams to give your lineup some added strength and elite rebounding.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Level 20 Amethyst Tobias Harris[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]No matter which team he’s been on, Tobias Harris finds his role and plays it to T. The 14-year veteran boasts the prototypical size for an NBA forward at 6’8”, and he uses it to score in myriad ways. Harris owns a solid career field goal percentage of 47.8%, a reliable 16.1 points per game, and can rebound well for his position with an average of 6.2. Insert Harris alongside Plum and Adams to round out a 3-player lineup with above average size.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Level 28 Amethyst Coach Billy Donovan[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Hard-working and dedicated to player development, former Oklahoma City Thunder Head Coach Billy Donovan has a wealth of experience at the collegiate and professional level. Maximize your lineup with the Level 28 Amethyst Coach Billy Donovan card and unlock two tiers of new Badge Training Challenges to improve your player cards without Badge cards.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Level 30 Diamond Trae Young[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]A cold-blooded shooter with ice in his veins, Level 30 Diamond Trae Young can make your opposition shiver with fright. Let Young run the point and leverage his slippery handles to freeze defenders in their tracks. Unleash a barrage of 3-pointers and put the game well out of reach with Young’s offensive arsenal.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Level 35 Pink Diamond A’ja Wilson[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][i]NBA 2K25 [/i]cover athlete A’ja Wilson joins a mix of potent Season 1 Player Cards ready to be deployed in your MyTEAM lineup. Dominate both ends of the court at an MVP level with the three-time Most Valuable Player, two-time WNBA Champion, and [i]NBA 2K25 [/i]cover athlete. Wilson does it all; she can score at will, protect the rim with superb blocking ability, and reel in rebounds with her 6’11” wingspan.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/716b5db8271fa3982b6206ce95193394616b5bb6.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Level 40 Pink Diamond Klay Thompson (Dallas Mavericks)[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Round out your roster with one of the most prolific shooters in NBA history, Klay Thompson. The former Splash Brother’s quick release and perfect shooting form have been a staple throughout his career, and can be a difference-maker on your MyTEAM. With the all-new No-Dip Catch-and-Shoots mechanic in [i]NBA 2K26[/i], you can swing the ball to Thompson lurking in the corner for an easy 3-pointer. Add Thompson and the aforementioned players to your collection in Season 1, and keep expanding it all year long.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/a6cdf3f4d29af0d977db3df18acd6233b069e615.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Here are some other available rewards during Season 1:[/p][list][*][p]Level 7 - ‘Cheater’ Game Changer Card x3[/p][/*][*][p]Level 11 - Season 1 Ball and Uniforms[/p][/*][*][p]Level 22 - ‘Gimme More’ Game Changer Card x3[/p][/*][*][p]Level 25 - 90+ OVR Pack[/p][/*][*][p]Level 32 - 10,000 MTP[/p][/*][*][p]Level 33 - 92+ OVR Pack[/p][/*][*][p]Level 37 - Hall of Fame Badges x2 [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]To learn more about the addition of WNBA Player Cards and other new features in MyTEAM this year, be sure to check out the [url="https://nba.2k.com/2k26/courtside-report/myteam/"][u]MyTEAM Courtside Report[/u][/url]![/p][p][/p][h1][b]SEASON PRO PASS**[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Increase your Season rewards track with the [i]NBA 2K26[/i] Season Pro Pass and Hall of Fame Pass. These seasonal add-ons are available for individual purchase and include an extra 40 tiers of rewards and content for you to enjoy.[/p][p][/p][p]Season 1 Automatic Rewards:[/p][list][*][p]Desert Camo Quilted Jacket[/p][/*][*][p]Tactical Bear Helmet[/p][/*][*][p]Season 1 Pro Pass Pack[/p][/*][*][p]Amethyst Kevin Durant[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/b4b99fcabd3b72aa009e6a685ab4650f3f52f067.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Earn MyCAREER rewards to flaunt around The City and MyTEAM cards to use in Triple Threat Park* and All-Star Team-Up*. Add a pair of Eastern Conference mascots and a throwback Vince Carter jersey from his high-flying days in Toronto. In addition to the cosmetics and cards, you can earn plenty of Skill Boosts, 2XP Coins, and up to 45,000 VC. [/p][p][/p][p]Season 1 Premium Rewards:[/p][list][*][p]Level 3 - Half-Skull Facepaint[/p][/*][*][p]Level 6 - Vince Carter Toronto Raptors Jersey[/p][/*][*][p]Level 12 - ‘Benny the Bull’ Chicago Bulls Mascot[/p][/*][*][p]Level 25 - ‘Make it Shine’ Game Changer Card x5[/p][/*][*][p]Level 30 - ‘Sir CC’ Cleveland Cavaliers Mascot[/p][/*][*][p]Level 39 - Biohazard Suit: Blackout[/p][/*][*][p]Level 40 - Pink Diamond Pro Pass Klay Thompson (Golden State Warriors)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/b641e90b90c0c14d32f7787af1ca6c8068bdd6cb.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]THE W ONLINE*[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]The WNBA regular season is coming down to the wire! With only a couple of weeks left before the WNBA Playoffs begin, teams on the cusp of missing the postseason are making a last-second push to try and sneak in. As the competition heats up, the intensity in The W Online will be palpable. Compete with friends and work with the community to complete all-new challenges for exciting rewards.[/p][p][/p][p]Take a look at some of the Season 1 rewards below: [/p][p][/p][p]Weekly Rewards[/p][list][*][p]Angel Reese Oversized T-Shirt[/p][/*][*][p]Animated Mohawk Hairstyle[/p][/*][*][p]Libra Top + Necklace[/p][/*][*][p]5 Game Team Accelerator Boost[/p][/*][*][p]Halloween Basketball[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Season Rewards[/p][list][*][p]WNBA Ball[/p][/*][*][p]WNBA Ball Card[/p][/*][*][p]Clothing Bundles[/p][/*][*][p]5,000 VC[/p][/*][*][p]MyTEAM Player Cards[/p][/*][*][p]Max +1 Tier 1[/p][/*][*][p]Max +1 Tier 2[/p][/*][*][p]Seasonal Perks[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]A new year of [i]NBA 2K[/i] starts during Season 1 of [i]NBA 2K26[/i]. notes.title: NBA 2K26: The City Courtside Report
notes.notes:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="3NvYwISbFn0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][i]NBA 2K26[/i] welcomes you back to The City on PlayStation®5, Xbox Series X|S, PC, and Nintendo Switch 2, where competition, community, and status lay the foundation of this burgeoning basketball mecca.[/p][p][/p][p]The City in [i]NBA 2K26[/i] is driven by hoops, with a more accessible and competitive layout to keep you on the court more often, and introduces a host of all-new features. Link with friends and form all-new Crews, compete in redesigned Parks, climb the leaderboard and revel in your success as the top MyPLAYER, and become basketball royalty in Street Kings.[/p][p][/p][p]Before you visit The City, take a second to learn more about the bevy of features available in [i]NBA 2K26[/i].[/p][p][/p][h1][b]THE CITY[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]The City in [i]NBA 2K26[/i] builds on [i]2K25[/i]’s goal of a more intimate and accessible world. You can see just about every area in The City no matter where you are standing, very quickly go from one place to another and, most importantly, get on the court faster.[/p][p][/p][p]Scan your surroundings and spot jetsetting planes and hovering helicopters that take flight in the distance, adding to the dynamic nature of this living, breathing environment. Based on community feedback, The City also received new lighting improvements including a fixed time-of-day that will reduce harsh shadows and sunlight when playing games outdoors in places like the Park. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/e751d598d95b34ee69cbbacf2e951a8962643085.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]2K26[/i]’s City features an open-air plaza, with the Gatorade Training Facility, Event Center, Arena, and other locations all within walking distance. The Theater, REC, Proving Grounds, and more line the perimeter of The City, making it easy to go door-to-door to play in all of the refreshed lobbies, courts, and arenas.
[/p][p]Stroll the stone walkways and observe the multiple directory boards prominently displaying leaderboards with the top MyPLAYERs and your Crew. Find your friends and start competing to climb the ranks in this bustling community of hoopers.
[/p][p]Take your first steps in The City and survey a world where everything is within reach.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/13d8fe29c8c6911a33d010def25810a227156ce9.jpg"][/img][/p][h1][b]SEASONAL PARKS[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Before The City developed into the thriving basketball metropolis we know today, there was the Park. Introduced in [i]NBA 2K14[/i], the Park was the birthplace of online MyPLAYER competition, where friends and the community could come together to enjoy pick-up games. [/p][p][/p][p]Long a defining part of [i]NBA 2K[/i], Parks are BACK in [i]NBA 2K26[/i] with bold new features to make every season and even every day a new experience.[/p][p][/p][p]The past few years, The City has been an amusement park of sorts, with fantastical regions and futuristic environments. [i]NBA 2K26[/i]’s new Parks are getting back to the basics with a more natural and grounded feel for a more realistic aesthetic, typical of what you’d see in a real-world environment.[/p][p][/p][p]Access the Park by entering the giant, rotating basketball that not only serves as the centerpiece of The City, but also as your gateway to a new location featuring stunning courts. [/p][p][/p][p]At the start of each new Season, every six weeks, a different Park environment will be introduced. Along with a number of new original designs, you will also find yourself playing in complete HD remasters of all four iconic [i]NBA 2K16 [/i]MyPARKs.[/p][p][/p][p]Season 1’s Park is a brand new locale called Skyline Park, set in a magnificent urban environment that captures the essence of hooping and competing on your favorite neighborhood courts. [/p][p][/p][p]Team up with your friends and visit the Park to start competing for bragging rights and rewards. To further celebrate the return of the Park, competition is incentivized with Park MVPs, Streak Setters, Streak Breakers, and a 25% REP Bonus to keep you coming back for bragging rights and leveling up.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/4a897b75989f3d9a338d603e3e8928e2398474ed.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Park MVPs[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The top REP player in each Park server will be marked with a Park MVP icon, visible above their head and also in the bird’s-eye view of the courts so that you can easily spot where they are playing. [/p][p][/p][p]Playing against the Park MVP can be a very rewarding experience. If you can defeat the Park MVP, you’ll earn [u]5XREP[/u] AND [u]5XVC[/u] for that game! The Park MVP bonus is earnable once every three hours, so get out there and chase them down.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/4143d5ee8a628a433c0208e461b69748b2be62f9.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Streak Setters[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Etch your greatness in the Park by setting the longest win streak for a court in the current season. The players with the longest streak on each court will have their names spotlighted right on the side of the court for all to see! Take over a court, rattle off consecutive wins, and stamp your name as the top MyPLAYER on the block.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Streak Breakers[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]On the flip side, derail another team’s active winning streaks to earn more VC. With the all-new Streak Breaker bonus, there’s real motivation to seek out the hottest teams in the Park and end their reign.[/p][p][/p][p]The longer your opponent’s streak, the more VC you’ll earn for snapping it. Start earning bonus VC by snapping five-game win streaks. Once a team reaches 20 wins in a row, every win after that adds 1,000 VC to the total you can earn for stopping them. For example, if you’re the one to end a 30-game win streak, you’ll earn a 30,000 VC bonus.[/p][p][/p][p]There’s no limit to how many Streak Breaker bonuses you can earn in a day, so reap the rewards with every streak you spoil.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/ae9f7f5341f40108199f91234345b061198c1fa5.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]REP Boost[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Boost your MyPLAYER REP in the Park with a 25% REP bonus! All Park games played in NBA 2K26 will activate a 25% REP boost; level up to earn rewards and upgrades to your on-court performance. Continue reading to learn more about the REP rewards available in [i]NBA 2K26[/i].[/p][p][/p][h1][b]CREWS[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Rally your friends and establish your own affiliation with an all-new feature in [i]2K26 [/i]called Crews. You can team up with your friends and community members to earn great rewards. [/p][p][/p][p]Crews can be tight-knit with you and your friends if you want, or grow up to 50 players. Crews offer flexibility and a more creative outlet for everyone. Your MyPLAYER nameplate will allow others to see which Crew you are representing, your Crew logo, and your Crew level to show off your progress![/p][p][/p][p]Simply play games or work with your Crew to complete weekly goals that help you rise through the ranks of all 30 Crew levels, earning rewards in the process, including:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Custom Crew logos [/p][/*][*][p]Custom branded Crew clothing featuring your own uploaded Crew logo[/p][/*][*][p]4 Cap Breakers and a Max +1 Badge Perk slot[/p][/*][*][p]VC or REP multipliers that activate when your Crew plays together[/p][/*][*][p]Unlimited Boosts[/p][/*][*][p]… and more![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]CHASE THE WIN[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Don’t just chase the win, pursue the throne. In [i]NBA 2K26[/i], there’s more than one way to let the world know you’re the best.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Leaderboards[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]There are new types of leaderboards throughout The City to track your accomplishments. [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Mode leaderboards spotlight the players with the most wins in Park, The Theater, The REC, Proving Grounds, Triple Threat Park, Starting 5, and Ante-Up. Leaderboards update daily, and a towering 12-foot statue of the No. 1 ranked player in each of these modes will be built outside that mode’s building, showcasing their success for all who enter to see.[/p][/*][*][p]Geo Rank leaderboards celebrate the most victorious players across the globe and allow you to filter by different geographical regions, including all 50 U.S. states. If you are one of the top players in any region of the world, you will get a custom show-off flair shown during your pre-game intro. Get out there and rep your home![/p][/*][*][p]Crew leaderboards track the winningest Crews and allows you to see which Crew truly runs The City.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/2aeff8b20fb9bbdd61a8f5b9c90981c0411edad6.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]REP & Legend[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The REP system from [i]NBA 2K25[/i] returns in [i]NBA 2K26[/i], but with fresh rewards. Players familiar with REP in The City will recognize the Rookie, Starter, Veteran, and Legend categories, and their five-tier structure. At each tier, players can unlock different rewards, ranging from Cap Breakers, Boosters, Animations, VC, and more.[/p][p] [/p][p]Earn your place in [i]NBA 2K26[/i] and accumulate REP to achieve Legend status.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]PRO-AM SUMMIT[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Twice a season, teams in The City will come together for the Pro-Am Summit to compete in 3v3 and 5v5 tournaments.[/p][p][/p][p]The Pro-Am Summit will happen every three weeks, with competitive play happening on Saturday and Sunday of Summit weekends. The first one will be on September 21-22, 2025. [/p][p][/p][p]To qualify, all your team needs to do is play 10 Pro-Am games together in the weeks leading up to the next Summit.[/p][p][/p][p]During Summit weekend, each game your team plays is scored based on the outcome and your performances. The leaderboard ranks each team by the sum of your five highest game scores from that weekend. The Top 5, Top 10, Top 50, and Top 100 teams will each receive elite rewards fit for the best organized teams in The City. [/p][p][/p][h1][b]STREET KINGS[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Rule the new Street Kings mode and lead your team to victory. [/p][p][/p][p]Last year, Streetball featured three courts spread out across The City, but this year we’ve condensed it to one convenient, new location, with lots of new features. Play solo or join forces with up to two friends and challenge skilled CPU bosses.[/p][p][/p][p]This all-in-one approach boasts a more cohesive design; players will be welcomed by an impressive collegiate-style building with Roman-inspired architectural features, with adjoining courts on opposite sides of the complex.[/p][p][/p][p]Street Kings is a great way to level up your MyPLAYER and earn 40 levels of rewards that will give you a truly unique look out in The City. Upgrade your Badges, test out new animations, and sharpen your skills on the Street Kings battlefield.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/c03a4141f5b3fcdd85eb1d89bb6c36b354796ed9.jpg"][/img][/p][h1][b]CHALLENGES[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]There’s always something new to do in [i]NBA 2K26[/i]. Challenges are a new feature in [i]2K26[/i] that offer a great way to both learn what The City has to offer and challenge you to see what heights you can reach. [/p][p][/p][p]To guide (and reward) you, The City now has new Beginner, Daily, Seasonal, and Lifetime challenges to earn VC, REP bonuses, exclusive cosmetics you can’t get anywhere else, and yes, even Cap Breakers.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Beginner: Take a tour of The City with these onboarding challenges, designed to help you find the game modes best suited to you, like checking out the new Park, visiting your MyCOURT, and upgrading your MyPLAYER.[/p][/*][*][p]Daily: Each day, you can complete three new challenges to earn VC. These are quick and easy tasks, like playing a game or collecting your Daily Reward. Completing all three will activate 1 hour of 2XREP. On top of that, if you’ve purchased the Pro Pass or Hall of Fame Pass, you’ll get even more bonus VC for completing all your Daily Challenges.[/p][/*][*][p]Seasonal: Each Season, there will be a variety of new challenges to earn VC, Season XP, and exclusive cosmetics.[/p][/*][*][p]Lifetime: Complete Challenges in each game mode all year long to earn even more rewards, including exclusive cosmetics you can wear in all game modes (including The REC), shoes that boost your out-of-game run speed by +200%, an emissive Mech Helmet, large quantities of VC, and yes, even Cap Breakers. There are 300 milestones in total, ensuring you always have something to chase.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]All you have to do is play, and the rewards will start flowing your way as you rack up stats and wins![/p][p][/p][h1][b]SWAP BUILD[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Alternate between MyPLAYER Builds with ease using the new Swap Build feature. Switch between your MyPLAYERs without leaving The City, removing the hassle of rejoining your squad and the server they’re in.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/7e827b81d95630b44eedfaef64fba71b9e32a708.gif"][/img][/p][h1][b]MyCOURT[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]MyCOURT is your dedicated space to work on your game. [/p][p][/p][p]Choose from new drill options to practice your free-throws, alley-oop catching, and putback dunk timing, or freestyle to master all of the new Gameplay mechanics in [i]NBA 2K26,[/i] like enhanced Rhythm Shooting, no-dip catch & shoots, and more. Learn about all the improvements to on-court Gameplay [u][url="https://nba.2k.com/2k26/courtside-report/gameplay/"]here[/url][/u]. For more focused practice, visit Learn 2K to improve your game with new additions that will make you a better player. [/p][p][/p][p]Your MyCOURT features new customization options that allow you to put your own stamp on the design. This year, you can customize the court floor with pre-designed floors earned through rewards, or you can even use the full arena court editor to design your own floor. [/p][p][/p][p]Control every detail from the wood colors, line colors, logos, and even the basket stanchion designs themselves can be customized to complete your look.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]THE TRACK[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Get back in the driver’s seat in [i]NBA 2K26[/i]—the Track is returning with two new vehicles and a massive VC reward every week![/p][p][/p][p]This year, we’re introducing Pocket Bikes and Drift Trikes for more vehicle variety and go-kart mayhem. Go head-to-head with friends via matchmaking, challenge random players online, and put the pedal to the metal to secure the fastest time and 1,000,000 VC! Create custom leaderboards for you and your friends, race their ghosts for endless competitive fun, and earn Season XP and VC on a weekly basis. [/p][p][/p][p]Start your engines MyPLAYERs, it’s time to run laps around the competition on the court and on the race track.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]MyCAREER: OUT OF BOUNDS[/b][/h1][p][/p][previewyoutube="7RJMtz98N20;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][i]NBA 2K26[/i]’s MyCAREER story, [i]Out of Bounds[/i], takes you on a journey as an unknown prospect from a small town in Vermont all the way to the NBA. [/p][p][/p][p]To be the best you have to beat the best. You’ll compete against top high school prospects in the country and join a club league team, all to prove you have what it takes to be drafted into the NBA. [/p][p][/p][p]Garner the attention of spectators and scouts as you showcase your skills. Make the most of your opportunities and outshine your opponents to make the Club League All-Star team. Play to win and complete objectives to improve your draft stock in the process.[/p][p][/p][p]Don’t take your playing time for granted and make the most of every possession.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The NBA Draft[/b][/h3][h3][/h3][p]This year, your MyPLAYER can go through the Draft process and be drafted based on your performance and how well you fit each team’s positional needs. Let fate run its course to see where you get drafted, or take control of your destiny and conduct a private workout for the team of your choice. Get drafted the traditional way or choose where you want to go—the decision is yours.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Passion Projects[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]While you’re putting in work on the court, your agent is grinding behind the scenes. In addition to endorsements, you will have the opportunity to do new passion projects. One of our favorites is a questline where you recruit NBA stars, like Cade Cunningham, to start their own club team in the league you create.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]NBA & The Playoffs[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The story doesn’t stop when the NBA season begins. Twice a season, you will select a new Key Game set, each with unique stories and cutscenes, including storylines with sponsors, your parents getting too involved, and more. [/p][p][/p][p]We don’t want to spoil all the surprises but, for the first time, the MyCAREER story can extend to the Playoffs if you can make the postseason and contend for a championship as a rookie.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]THANK YOU[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]All of the work that went into [i]NBA 2K26 [/i]wouldn’t be possible without all of you. So on behalf of everyone at Visual Concepts, thank you for your passion and feedback. From The City to MyTEAM, the lifelike gameplay enhancements, and more, we can’t wait for you to experience it all in [i]NBA 2K26[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]If you haven’t already, be sure to check out the [u][url="https://nba.2k.com/2k26/courtside-report/"]Courtside Reports hub[/url][/u] for more details about gameplay and game modes in [i]NBA 2K26[/i]. Stay tuned for more news and updates throughout the year by following [i]NBA 2K[/i] across all of our social platforms.[/p][p][/p][p]Pre-order [i]NBA 2K26 Superstar [/i]or [i]Leave No Doubt Edition[/i] and get up to 7 days of Early Access**, starting August 29.[/p][p][/p][p][i]*Only available on NBA 2K26 for PlayStation®5, Xbox Series X|S, PC, and Nintendo Switch 2.[/i][/p][p][i]**Early access only available for NBA 2K26 Superstar and Leave No Doubt Editions (Digital) only available on Playstation®5 and Xbox Series X|S and PC. Availability restrictions apply. For details, see [/i][url="https://nba.2k.com/2k26/faq/"]nba.2k.com/2k26/faq/[/url][i].[/i][/p]

notes.title: NBA 2K26: MyNBA & MyGM Courtside Report
notes.notes: [p]MyNBA and MyGM* return in [i]NBA 2K26 [/i]on PC, with a bevy of additions and enhancements to make this limitless General Manager experience even more memorable and rewarding. [/p][p][/p][p]From the ability to play in the NBA Playoffs online to improved simulations, dynamic banners, offseason MyGM scenarios, and more, this year builds on the rich history of this iconic mode with expanded features. You have the power to reshape the league and leave an indelible mark by constructing the next great dynasty—are you ready to learn more?[/p][p][/p][h2][b]ONLINE PLAYOFFS[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Legends are made in the playoffs—in [i]NBA 2K26,[/i] “The Playoffs” mode can now be played online in MyNBA.[/p][p][/p][p]The NBA Finals have a way of ratcheting up the competition and intensifying every possession. Whether you challenge your friends or other players, the increased pressure of this mode will be palpable. As commissioner of each bracket, you will be responsible for selecting and seeding all 16 NBA teams that clinch a spot in the Playoffs. Once that’s complete, you can invite up to 15 friends to participate in a private postseason, or open it up to the public and search for community members to join in. Whether you keep it tight-knit or make it a free-for-all, the addition of The Playoffs online is a fresh way to compete at the highest level.[/p][p][/p][p]Online Playoffs will feature the signature presentation of the NBA Playoffs, every aspect of the game will get the full playoff treatment—players, arenas, commentators, you name it will be in postseason mode. These subtle details will heighten the overall atmosphere and elevate the experience to feel more authentic.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/4d7a531caa77ca422a6f7b4d21c2b1196e90a184.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]IMPROVED & ADJUSTABLE SIMULATIONS[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The community has been vocal about wanting smarter, more efficient simulations—we heard you. This year, we’ve fine-tuned simulation performance under the hood to yield more strategic decisions that run 8% faster on average and up to 26% faster in [i]NBA 2K26[/i] compared to [i]NBA 2K25[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]Players now have the freedom to adjust simulations by toggling between three options: Normal, Smarter, and Faster. [/p][p][/p][p]‘Smarter’ sims will utilize more advanced trade logic that can consider over 5,000 potential trade assets and variables per trade, such as trade protections and pick swaps, to best mirror real-life front office strategies, but will conduct the sim at a slower rate in order to do so.[/p][p][/p][p]‘Faster’ sims will progress through seasons more quickly, while still making tactical decisions. The core rules behind the salary cap, trades, and free agency will be respected. Still, sims may not consider every possible outcome—pick protection or swaps—when evaluating a team’s asset stockpile. If you’re interested in getting into the action quicker, then this is for you, especially when you’re committed to building dynasties that span decades.[/p][p][/p][p]Experiment with each of the Normal, Smarter, and Faster functions to tailor the MyNBA experience to your needs.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]MyPLAYER DNA[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The Player DNA system is expanding in [i]NBA 2K26[/i] with a new MyPLAYER DNA option to copy and paste one MyPLAYER into each roster you create. Using a MyCAREER save file, you can faithfully clone your MyPLAYER’s appearance, animations, attributes, badges, and tendencies in MyNBA with ease. [/p][p][/p][p]This system works in all of the MyNBA Eras, so you can insert your MyPLAYER into any period and see how they measure up against the legends of the game. You can also see how they’d look with retro presentation filters and how their playstyle adapts to the evolution of league rules.[/p][p][/p][p]Explore endless possibilities and put the age-old question of whether modern players could handle the physicality of previous eras to the test.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/8dfcae408b0ec56e59644c9079e886d8051f5677.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]DYNAMIC BANNERS[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]When your career as a general manager comes to an end, how will you be remembered? Your ability to deliver championships to a fanbase will be the hallmark of your legacy, and in [i]NBA 2K26[/i] you can celebrate these crowning achievements through all-new dynamic banners in the Modern Era.[/p][p][/p][p]Bask in your team’s success as you watch banners rise from the hardwood and into the rafters, where they’ll hang beside retired franchise legends. Each NBA arena has a dedicated section for these banners and, as you play out your story, you’ll see years of history represented through championships and decorated stars. Take pride in your accomplishments; whether it’s acknowledging your development of an auto-generated rookie into a Hall of Famer or a dynasty you built achieving an elusive three-peat.[/p][p][/p][p]This key component in the MyNBA experience is something the Visual Concepts team has wanted to incorporate for a long time, and we’re incredibly proud to deliver it to you in [i]2K26[/i].[/p][p][/p][h2][b]MyWNBA EXPANSION[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]A new challenger has entered the mix! The WNBA is adding another franchise to its ranks, welcoming the Golden State Valkyries into the league. With 2025 serving as their inaugural season, the Valkyries have officially been added to MyWNBA in [i]NBA 2K26[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]Make the Valkyries’ first season in the Bay a memorable one and waste no time establishing them as a contender in the WNBA.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]MyNBA DIRECTIVES[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Before a new season, you’ll sit down with the team governor to assess your goals and budget for the year. During this conversation, the team governor will assign you primary and secondary directives to influence your strategy for the season. It’s imperative that you meet these directives to keep your job as general manager.[/p][p][/p][p]Team governors vary from team to team, some are driven by championships at any cost, while others are focused on the balance sheet and want to ensure the arena is filled and profitability continues. Combined with team-specific offseason scenarios, your experience will change based on the team you’ve selected, keeping challenges fluid and stimulating.[/p][p][/p][p]At the end of the season, the team governor will review your directives and goals for the year, and evaluate whether you met expectations. If you do, you’ll be rewarded with a bigger budget that can be used during the offseason to target premier players or renovate your facilities.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Team Finances & Facilities[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Managing the team ledger is a necessary part of running a successful franchise. Team finances have been tweaked to be more reflective of each MyNBA era, with accurate team revenue and budgets, luxury tax mechanics, year-to-year salary cap increases, and more throughout league history.[/p][p][/p][p]Maintaining a quality product in the NBA is challenging; make it easier on yourself by keeping your facilities up to date to increase player interest in your organization. Upgrade your facilities with Facility Points—earned by winning championships—which can go toward updating Team Training, Team Recovery, Arena, and more:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Team Training Facilities: Your players will have improved strength, hustle, and potential. Upgraded training facilities can also influence player interest in negotiation; they're less likely to want to play for a team with shabby facilities.[/p][/*][*][p]Team Recovery Facilities: Your players will be more durable, with a reduced chance of injury and faster recovery times. This can also give you a boost in contract negotiations.[/p][/*][*][p]Luxury Box Amenities: Go the extra mile and raise the value of your luxury boxes. These premium seats will get fans in the door, allow you to raise your ticket prices, and ultimately boost profits in the long run.[/p][/*][*][p]Fan Event: Host a fan event that boosts the attendance for a single game by 15%.[/p][/*][*][p]Arena Renovations: A state-of-the-art arena gives a +20% boost to your attendance, which drops by 1% each year as your arena degrades. Renovating will restore the attendance boost to full strength and give you the chance to redesign or rename the arena. However, renovations are a costly, multi-year project and require 15 Facility Points so be sure to plan ahead.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Find success on the court by investing in your franchise’s foundation with upgrades to your facilities and amenities. Garner attention from marquee free agents around the league and show them you’re serious about winning.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/55d4a1de3c9b2bf557a8f94d63416b78f07dddc5.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]MyGM[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]MyGM made its long-awaited return in [i]NBA 2K25[/i], and this year it’s back again, but bigger and better than ever. Immerse yourself in the role of a general manager and live out 30 unique team storylines, with narratives from real-world inspiration.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Offseason Scenarios[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]One of the biggest updates to MyGM is the addition of 30 team-specific storylines, with a total of 98 different conversations available in [i]NBA 2K26[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]Your journey begins amid the 2025 offseason, following the conclusion of the NBA Draft Lottery and NBA Finals. Based on the team you choose, you’ll be faced with the same obstacles and roster needs as your real-world GM counterpart; here are a few examples:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Chicago Bulls embrace a full rebuild focused on acquiring draft picks.[/p][/*][*][p]Build for the Golden State Warriors’ future or commit to another Finals run with Stephen Curry.[/p][/*][*][p]Dallas Mavericks make Cooper Flagg the new face of the franchise with the No. 1 draft pick.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Work with your head coach, CFO, team scout, and team governor to problem-solve and improve team needs.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]MyGM Building[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The MyGM Building is your home base for all team activities. Here, you’ll receive new tasks, discuss the ongoing strategy of the team, and fill out your staff, including the assistant GM. Feel the energy of a buzzing office atmosphere, observe practice at the team gym, and even get some shots up while wearing your suit and tie. The MyGM Building now feels bigger and more energetic as you go about your responsibilities.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Your GM Legacy[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The new GM Legacy menu will track your objectives and successes in each save. How many championships have you won? Were you able to draft a future MVP? Show off what you have accomplished over your MyGM journey. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Unlock Clothing[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]If you’re in the driver’s seat of an NBA organization, you’ve got to look the part. Keep yourself looking fresh with new suit designs and customization options for you to choose from. Unlock these fitted threads by completing high-scoring runs.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Unranked MyGM[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]When we re-introduced MyGM in [i]NBA 2K25[/i], every run was scored and ranked, which required everyone to be on the same playing field.[/p][p][/p][p]In [i]NBA 2K26[/i], you can choose to do an Unranked MyGM run. You can edit players, import custom rosters and draft classes, and adjust sliders for a more customized experience that retains the role-playing elements of the mode.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]COMING UP NEXT[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]There’s so much to unpack in MyNBA this year and we’re eager for you to experience it yourself. In the meantime, be sure to check out the [url="https://nba.2k.com/2k26/courtside-report/gameplay/"][u]Gameplay[/u][/url], [url="https://nba.2k.com/2k26/courtside-report/myplayer-builder/"][u]MyPLAYER[/u][/url], [url="https://nba.2k.com/2k26/courtside-report/presentation/"][u]Presentation[/u][/url], [url="https://nba.2k.com/2k26/courtside-report/myteam/"]MyTEAM[/url], and [url="https://nba.2k.com/2k26/courtside-report/the-w/"]The W [/url]Courtside Reports if you haven’t already. The final Courtside Report drops the week of August 25, detailing this year’s accessible City. Stay tuned to all of the official [i]NBA 2K[/i] social platforms to get the latest news about this year’s exciting features. [/p][p][/p][p][i]*Only available on NBA 2K26 for PlayStation®5, Xbox Series X|S, PC, and Nintendo Switch 2.[/i][/p]

notes.title: NBA 2K26: The W Courtside Report
notes.notes: [p]More rivalries, more attention, more hoops—The W* is back in [i]NBA 2K26[/i] on PC.[/p][p][/p][p]The WNBA is growing rapidly, and as a promising rookie class featuring Paige Bueckers, Kiki Iriafen, Sonia Citron, and more enter the fold, everyone is wondering who will challenge the league’s star-studded landscape and emerge as the next superstar talent. This year, clash with your rivals on the court, capture the global audience with your sensational play, and speak your legacy into existence as you pursue GOAT aspirations.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]PRE-DRAFT INTERVIEW[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Your WNBA journey officially begins after building your MyPLAYER—take center stage at an interactive pre-draft press conference and field questions from the media about the next step in your career. With each question and every answer, where you land in the draft will become more clear. Do you want to be the first franchise player in Golden State Valkyries history, or do you want to add more trophies to a decorated franchise? Ultimately, you’ll be given the power to choose which WNBA team you want to play for; whether you select the option provided or force your way to another team, it’s entirely up to you.[/p][p][/p][p]During your introductory presser, your story will start to take shape and you’ll get a glimpse at some of the potential rivalries you’ll face throughout your career.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/8464952e86ac4acd1b61d563e46d1defb4750a3a.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]GOAT CHALLENGES[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The road to becoming an all-time great isn’t easy—and it shouldn’t be. You have to prove you’re worthy of that title, which means defeating current stars and climbing the all-time ranks.[/p][p][/p][p]Whenever you beat a rival WNBA star, you’ll receive their contact information to stay in touch, and you’ll also unlock short-term and long-term GOAT Challenges. Completing these GOAT Challenges will earn you GOAT points that contribute to your ascension up the all-time ladder. Add to your prestige and receive on-court enhancements in the process, like Skill Boosts, badge progression modifiers, and more.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/1a34603bb760f2d46b3253378ccb00e02f45723a.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]CONNECT WITH SOCIAL MEDIA[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]As your star power rises, more and more WNBA personalities and media will be talking about your career. We’ve expanded and refreshed the social media feature in [i]NBA 2K26[/i] to be more representative of the current state of the league. Due to the evergrowing coverage of the WNBA, you’ll see and hear from notable real-world journalists and pundits during the season, including:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Nekias Duncan ([url="https://x.com/NekiasNBA"]@NekiasNBA[/url])[/p][/*][*][p]Myles Ehrlich ([url="https://twitter.com/mylesehrlich"]@MylesEhrlich[/url])[/p][/*][*][p]Terrika Foster-Brasby ([url="https://twitter.com/sheknowssports"]@sheknowssports[/url])[/p][/*][*][p]Jordan Robinson ([url="https://twitter.com/HeyJordanR"]@HeyJordanR[/url])[/p][/*][*][p]Mark Schindler ([url="https://twitter.com/MG_Schindler"]@MG_Schindler[/url])[/p][/*][*][p]Khristina Williams ([url="https://twitter.com/Khristina"]@Khristina[/url])[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Engage with the media and watch your following grow as you accomplish your goals. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]PRESS CONFERENCES[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Your on-court performances will do much of the talking for you, but press conferences in [i]NBA 2K26[/i] are a great way for you to weigh in on the relevant stories circulating around the league. Featuring authentic voice recordings and motion capture, press conferences in The W boast brand new content for you to interact with, from Rookie of the Year contenders to ongoing rivalries for richer and deeper immersion.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/59fdd95ba1f2f56534a3aef3a7e6c510ef8c4810.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]THE W ONLINE REWARDS[/b][/h2][p]Take your skills online in multiplayer matches to earn new rewards, including mascot outfits and costumes. For the first time, you can also earn VC in The W Online games![/p][p][/p][p]But that’s not all, because you’ll also be able to earn new WNBA Player Cards to take your MyTEAM to the next level, plus Coach Cards and Uniform Cards. In case you missed it, [i]NBA 2K26 [/i]MyTEAM features fully playable WNBA players, past and present.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]COMING UP NEXT[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]This year, define your career and share it with the world through social media and press conferences. Join the pantheon of WNBA legends who came before you and establish yourself as the undisputed GOAT, earning the respect of your fellow stars along the way. Put your skills to the test in The W Online, and reap the reward of all-new items.[/p][p][/p][p]Coming up next, we’ve got the MyNBA and City Courtside Reports. Stay tuned for more details and updates about [i]NBA 2K26[/i]’s added features.[/p][p][/p][p][i]*The W is only available for Gen 9 versions of NBA 2K26.[/i][/p]

notes.title: WNBA players to play alongside NBA stars in NBA 2K26 MyTeam for the first time with new game mode announced
notes.notes:
Women’s NBA players are set to take the court alongside their male NBA counterparts in NBA 2K26’s MyTeam mode for the first time. WNBA players will appear in all MyTeam game modes, including the new Breakout: Gauntlet mode where players complete a series of matches where the difficulty gets harder and harder, but they can only use each card in the collection once.

notes.title: NBA 2K26: MyTEAM Courtside Report
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="_MgUp-Pa9r8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]For the first time ever, you’ll be able to collect and play with WNBA Player Cards, and pair them with your favorite NBA superstars on the same team. This is a massive milestone in [i]NBA 2K[/i] history and it’s been a long time coming.[/p][p][/p][p]While this is a major addition, it’s not the only one in [i]2K26[/i]. This year features new Game Changer Cards, All-Star Team-Up, a new arena featuring your MyTEAM accolades, and much more! So without further ado, let’s break down MyTEAM in [i]NBA 2K26[/i].[/p][p][/p][h2][b]THE WNBA JOINS MyTEAM[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]For the first time in [i]NBA 2K [/i]history, the WNBA is officially joining MyTEAM in [i]NBA 2K26[/i]![/p][p][/p][p]This monumental milestone means that you can form unique pairings between Jalen Brunson and Angel Reese, Lisa Leslie and Nikola Jokić, and countless others! Imagine throwing a lob with Paige Bueckers to Cooper Flagg, or torching the defense dropping 4-pointers with Stephen Curry and Caitlin Clark as your backcourt tandem. [/p][p][/p][p]The WNBA is fully integrated into every aspect of MyTEAM’s features and game modes. Experiment with lineup combinations the sport has never seen before and get creative as you find the perfect balance for each format.[/p][p][/p][p]Attributes and Badges function identically for all WNBA and NBA Player Cards, ensuring a balanced and consistent gameplay experience regardless of who you’re controlling. In addition to mixing and matching WNBA and NBA superstars, all WNBA uniforms have been added along with the entire league’s set of court floors. These courts include an added NBA three-point line to maintain a seamless experience across all MyTEAM competitive modes.[/p][p][/p][p]Now with WNBA inclusion in MyTEAM, we’ve added a dedicated WNBA Domination tier, where you can compete against the league using a lineup of WNBA stars. Create a lineup featuring exclusively WNBA players and challenge teams around the Association to earn those coveted Domination stars and crests for rewards.[/p][p][/p][p]These never-before-seen lineups wouldn’t be the same without a colorful broadcast crew to capture the magnitude of NBA and WNBA players competing side-by-side. [i]NBA 2K26[/i] presentation has been updated with the iconic voices of Kevin Harlan, Greg Anthony, and Stan Van Gundy, including new commentary and reactions to deliver their patented dynamic and insightful coverage.* Feel the energy and excitement of WNBA and NBA stars coming together in this groundbreaking MyTEAM development.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/80f55f3e5a4b1408217a6b1a1fe34ae0022bd175.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]ALL-NEW GAME CHANGER CARDS[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]WNBA Player Cards entering the MyTEAM landscape will open the realm of possibility in Domination and throughout the entire mode—but they’re not the only difference-maker being introduced in [i]2K26[/i]. [/p][p][/p][p]This year welcomes all-new Game Changer Cards, a brand new type of card that’s different from anything you’ve ever encountered before. These cards give you the power to cater your MyTEAM experience to your liking, with increased rewards and making your Player Cards more powerful.[/p][p][/p][p]These consumable cards grant special power-ups, including: [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Activating a REP or MyTEAM Points multiplier for your next game.[/p][/*][*][p]Recovering a win streak in Showdown after a loss.[/p][/*][*][p]Auto-winning a Breakout game without playing it.[/p][/*][*][p]Earning an extra prize or recovering a loss during a Breakout run.[/p][/*][*][p]Instantly completing an Exhibition Mission.[/p][/*][*][p]Auto-evolving an Evolution card.[/p][/*][*][p]Reducing the difficulty or target score differential in Domination.[/p][/*][*][p]…and [i][b]dozens[/b] [/i]more![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/a103e1f55b84dd960fbd4eb6cef95cceac92914f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]MyTEAM in [i]2K26[/i] is a game changer, literally and figuratively. Approach the game with the mindset to break the mold and play your way. Rethink the way MyTEAM is played and find an angle that no one else has discovered.[/p][p][/p][p]Get a head start with Game Changer cards in [i]NBA 2K26[/i] by completing the [i]2K26 [/i]Challenge in [i]2K25[/i]’s MyTEAM right now! On top of selecting an All-Star Series 1 player for your collection, you will also receive 5 Game Changer cards that each double your MyTEAM Points earned in a game in various MyTEAM modes. This is a great way to get started and build your MTP for the Auction House! Learn how to participate in the challenge below:[/p][p][/p][olist][*][p]Enter Locker Code "2K26-COVER-ATHLETES-MyTEAM" for a 100 OVR Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Invincible Carmelo Anthony, and Pink Diamond Angel Reese Coach Card in [i]2K25[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Head to Lifetime Challenges in MyTEAM and play the "[i]2K26[/i] MyTEAM Challenge" using 100 OVR Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Invincible Carmelo Anthony in your lineup.[/p][/*][*][p]Defeat previous [i]NBA 2K[/i] cover athletes in a Triple Threat game to 21 points and earn Invincible Devin Booker.[/p][/*][*][p]When you download and play [i]2K26[/i], an All-Star Option Pack and 5 Game Changer cards will be waiting for you.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]Make sure to take advantage of this offer before it expires on Friday, August 22, 2025 at 8 a.m. PT![/p][p][/p][h2][b]TRIPLE THREAT PARK AT NIGHT*[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]In [i]NBA 2K26[/i] the sound of waves lapping and the sunbaked courts from [i]NBA 2K15[/i]’s Sunset Beach are returning with a remixed look and feel. When the sun sets on this gorgeous venue, Triple Threat Park will come alive with neon lights that accent the tropical environment.[/p][p][/p][p]Triple Threat Park boasts four head-to-head 3v3 courts, including a new one on the newly opened boardwalk near the beach. At the center of the park, there are three 3v3 courts for 6-player co-op games.[/p][p][/p][p]Based on community feedback, the top REP player on your team will provide your uniforms and the top REP player in the game will bring their basketball.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/44f9b35088e616fe15bfb9da40bbd098f3b0b85f.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]Team Up in 2v2[/b][/h3][p]Another first in MyTEAM: 2v2 games![/p][p][/p][p]By the MyTEAM Store and Showcase Spot, you’ll find two all-new 2v2 half-courts in the middle of the street with chain nets. [/p][p][/p][p]These are co-op style games, where each person controls 1 Player Card. Grab your duo and lock in for “make it, take it” games where every possession matters.[/p][p][i][b]More Rewards[/b][/i][/p][p]Community-favorite reward mechanics for going on win streaks and climbing the seasonal wins ladder return and are expanded. Daily Win Streak rewards can now stretch beyond the three prizes earned every day during [i]2K25[/i], with even more prizing available each day and during events in [i]2K26[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]Earn more rewards with every W each Season, with Seasonal Ladder prizes available directly from the Triple Threat Park menu. In addition to easily accessible rewards, the final reward of each Season is repeatable for unlimited rewards![/p][p][/p][p]Finally, daily Streak Busters are coming to Triple Threat Park. These are rewards for shutting down win streaks of increasing length. When you break an opponent’s streak, you’ll earn all the rewards from the tiers below. For example, if you break a 15-game streak, you’ll earn the rewards for breaking a 5-game, 10-game, and 15-game streak all at once.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]ALL-STAR TEAM-UP*[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Tell your friends: MyTEAM is the new home of All-Star Team-Up in [i]2K26[/i]![/p][p][/p][p]In All-Star Team-Up you can compete in 10-player, 5v5 co-op games with your friends, or random players. These fast-paced games feature 6-minute halves and can be accessed from a portal in Triple Threat Park or from the MyTEAM menu.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/c2b2f731875a45ee8d61b22dd650a6019874db99.gif"][/img][/p][p]All-Star Team-Up requires that you and four teammates each prioritize your five favorite NBA or WNBA Player Cards—they must be position eligible—and just like in Triple Threat Park, whoever has the highest REP will have the first choice.[/p][p][/p][p]Accumulate new rewards individually with a new Season Ladder, with the same repeating final prize mechanic as Triple Threat Park. [/p][p][/p][p]You can also earn rewards as a team by defeating opposing teams to collect wins. For every 5 games you win with the same squad, everyone will receive a reward, even if the wins aren’t consecutive. Develop chemistry on the court with your squad and climb the Seasonal rewards ladder together.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]KING OF THE COURT, PRESENTED BY AT&T**[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]King of the Court is where the best of the best in MyTEAM compete for the best rewards and we’re taking it to the next level on Gen 9 platforms.[/p][p][/p][p]In [i]NBA 2K26[/i], no. 1 finishers on PC will each receive 1 Million VC for King of the Court.[/p][p][/p][p]Based on community feedback, it is now easier to participate. First, we’ve expanded King of the Court to take place during a full-weekend window, starting Fridays at 3:00 pm Pacific Time until Sundays at 11:59 pm Pacific Time, to be more accessible. [/p][p][/p][p]The qualification criteria is also simpler and now checks to see how much REP you’ve earned in the preceding week, allowing you to qualify by playing in any MyTEAM mode or by completing Challenges. [/p][p][/p][p]Once you enter King of the Court games, you will notice that the game difficulty will be set to a more competitive slider set compared to MyTEAM’s other multiplayer modes. Be sure to practice your Player Cards’ shots before jumping in![/p][p][/p][p]The leaderboard ranks the sum of each player’s four best Game Scores during that weekend, with four tiers of rewards each event. Three losses will freeze your score, similar to [i]2K25[/i]. Tier requirements are loosely based on the 1%, 10%, and 50% thresholds from [i]2K25[/i]; however, they will lock in hours before the end of the event to prevent score fluctuation as the remaining games are finalized at the buzzer.[/p][p][/p][p]Continue beating your own high scores to climb the leaderboard. Even if you don’t win the grand prize, everyone who qualifies and plays three games, win or lose, takes home a reward.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]BREAKOUT: GAUNTLET[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Another new game mode within Breakout is Gauntlet, where you put your entire collection to the test by completing games of increasing difficulty.[/p][p][/p][p]Gauntlet features a new straight-line game board—but there’s a twist. As you progress from Rookie difficulty to more challenging difficulties, you’ll only be able to use each of your Player Cards once per run. With Triple Threat, Clutch Time, and quick Full Lineup games, depth is your friend in this game mode, but so is understanding how to maximize every card in your collection. [/p][p][/p][p]Each game has Objectives that can be completed to return eligibility for a random card you’ve already used during this run. As the difficulty gets higher, more Objectives will become available each game, giving you more opportunities to gain back some of your used Player Cards.[/p][p][/p][p]The longer you continue a run, the better the rewards will be with a regularly updated final reward at the end of the path. There are prize games along the sides of the board every three spots, so after every three wins, you can optionally go up against gatekeeper teams to earn  rewards.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/0b7d9fcf54e213f8091babdd72205759ac52428a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i][b]More Breakout Improvements[/b][/i][/p][p]Based on community feedback, Breakout as a whole is even more rewarding in [i]2K26[/i]. Facing a gatekeeper team in Breakout no longer ends your run and instead takes away one of your three allowed prizes or losses, so you can continue playing on boards to earn up to three rewards in each run.[/p][p][/p][p]As you unlock neighboring spots on Breakout boards, you’ll notice new reward mini-game spots to receive Ball Drops, Ascension picks, Wheel Spins, Door Game searches, or Vault openings! Redeeming these free spots does not count towards your three prizes or losses per run—they’re simply more rewards available on the board![/p][p][/p][p]With these free spots being added, it could be a lot more difficult to trigger warps to other boards with fewer games available. To counter this, Breakout will see more focused and frequent updates to the lineup classes available on the initial board. Teams from the 1980s may be featured with their warp board available, while another update could see brand new lineup classes added with never-before-seen opponents for your lineups. New triggers have also been added to generate warps, but those will need to be discovered by the community.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]SINGLE PLAYER SALARY CAP[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Salary Cap mode returns in [i]NBA 2K26[/i]—now with the option to play in single player games. The AI opponents you’ll face in single player games are real lineups created by other community members under the same salary cap restrictions.[/p][p][/p][p]Both single-player Salary Cap and multiplayer Salary Cap Online feature the same rewards track, but multiplayer games grant double Round Points for faster progression. Higher single-player difficulties also have the ability to speed up your progress in comparison to lower difficulties.[/p][p][/p][p]Similar to the updates in Triple Threat Park and All-Star Team-Up, Salary Cap’s round-based prizing will also include a repeatable final reward, just in case you can’t get enough Salary Cap action with its unique game format of two halves and a fixed-score ending.[/p][p][/p][p]Bridge the gap between single-player and multiplayer modes to keep things fresh and exciting in [i]2K26[/i].[/p][p][/p][h2][b]GETTING STARTED[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]At the start of your MyTEAM journey, choose between two 5-card lineups to play as, each with a mix of current and historic NBA and WNBA players.[/p][p][/p][p]Test these cards in a quick, 3-minute game and afterwards you’ll receive two Free Agent Option Packs, one with Diamond-rated Current Players that can be used for 25 games, and the other with Pink Diamond-rated Legend Players that can be used for 15 games. These option packs will include the NBA and WNBA cards in the game you just played.[/p][p][/p][p]For new or returning players, start your collection with rewards from the MyTEAM Tutorial. Here, you will experience the basics of MyTEAM [i]2K26[/i], from the new Coaching staff features, upgrading your player cards, and earning a Clutch Time lineup’s worth of players. Plus, this is how you earn the first of the five traditional evolution Starter players![/p][p][/p][h2][b]MyTEAM ARENA*[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Bask in all of your achievements in the new starting location on Gen 9 platforms—the MyTEAM Arena.[/p][p][/p][p]This arena proudly displays banners, trophies, and murals from all of your accomplishments on the court and across the mode. This includes reaching Level 40 in a Season, getting promoted to Tier 1 in Showdown, collecting all the Player Card gems, completing feats across all MyTEAM modes, and more. Plus, there are special additions for the talented few that win King of the Court, or reach the Dark Matter Tier in MyTEAM REP.[/p][p][/p][p]Your MyTEAM Arena features lots of natural light and stunning views of the neighboring buildings. Pack your stadium with dedicated fans as you progress and continue playing MyTEAM.[/p][p][/p][p]The MyTEAM Arena is the initial home for every MyTEAM this year. NBA arenas will still be available to swap in, but the MyTEAM Arena is your trophy room and home turf.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/d26b4c272206dc402e479f54e4b2890b21007dfb.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]COACH DEVELOPMENT[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]In addition to getting Badge Cards from packs or the Auction House, there is a new way you can invest in and improve your Player Cards. In [i]2K26[/i], you can build out your coaching staff with up to five Coach Cards and expand a new skill tree to unlock powerful badges to add to your Player Cards.[/p][p]Coach Cards now have five categories for you to prioritize: Strategy, Leadership, Mentorship, Knowledge, and Team Management. You choose which category to assign your coach in your franchise, which will unlock Badge Training Challenges. The higher your Coach Card’s gem level & skills, the more powerful badges you can access by redeeming Coach Points.[/p][p]Coach Points will be made available at every REP tier and from Season Rewards. Redeem them wisely in your coach’s assigned category to unlock the badges that will help your Player Cards the most. If you decide to make a coaching change, your unlocked progress will remain even if you decide to swap Coach Cards or move your coach to a different category. As you increase your REP level, you will open more slots to add to your coaching staff, making more Badge Training Challenges available.[/p][p]Once unlocked, Badge Training Challenges can be started from the Challenges menu. Select which player you want to add the badge to and complete an in-game challenge with them to add it, no Badge Cards required![/p][p]Coach Cards will continue to provide in-game boosts in certain situations or for the entire game. If you have multiple active Coach Cards on your staff, selecting a Head Coach will grant access to that coach’s in-game boost.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/10b0f1037a4fd9eb96e09e7ea19a10bb002661ca.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]VICTORY CARDS & THE EXCHANGE[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]When you win a game in MyTEAM’s competitive modes (Showdown, Salary Cap Online, and King of the Court) you will earn a Victory Card that not only has the REP gem tier of the opponent you beat, but also their team logo, game date, final score, game mode, and whether or not the opponent rage quit![/p][p][/p][p]Conquer opponents with high REP levels, collect their Victory Cards, and exchange them for rewards in The Exchange.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/9486b7f278dc1d875bcb3d9289985d1dd1564e6f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]There are also new ways to exchange your cards and receive rewards for duplicates or unused cards in your collection. [/p][p][/p][p]New OVR-based Exchanges may accept player cards of any gem tier, but the average rating of those cards must meet a minimum OVR rating. Exchange Chains must be done consecutively for more powerful rewards. Finally, Exchange Groups are multiple exchanges within a category and completing them all will earn you an additional group reward.[/p][p][/p][p]Based on community feedback, Exchanges can now also access the cards in your My Auctions menu (which can again be expanded by REPing up this year) where more cards can be stored before being swapped for rewards.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]MyTEAM REP[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]REP is a status indicator in many respects throughout MyTEAM, and to see so many members of the community showcase their REP rewards, like the MyTEAM Coliseum and player banners, means a lot to us here at Visual Concepts. We’re excited to immortalize our Top REP players from [i]2K25[/i] on the Top REP Court which is included in everyone’s starter kit in [i]2K26[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]Shortening the grind between REP rewards was a common feedback item from the community. This year, many of the REP tiers now have multiple sub-tiers so that you can earn more rewards, more often. [/p][p][/p][p]Reach Dark Matter REP in 2K26 to earn a group of truly ‘Out of this World’ rewards, and one of the most iconic Carmelo Anthony aliases of all time: [i][b]G.O.A.T. Hoodie Melo! [/b][/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/05ac45723ccd8b730e001866b9456cb2cc51c656.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]…AND MORE![/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]More Showdown Rewards[/b][/h3][p]Showdown returns with weekly rewards giving you the choice between three rewards based on how many wins you get that week. This year, you can preview the weekly rewards available in the different tiers, helping you chart your path to the increased rewards in the higher tiers.[/p][p][/p][p]As you reach a promotion to a new tier, you will receive new rewards immediately when you rank up. Plus, the Season Win rewards have been expanded with more rewards for more wins.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Domination Update[/b][/h3][p]Domination now features new looks and formats, and a new reward called Crests. Every Domination game now includes an extra challenge available at the 3 Star difficulty. Complete the challenge and win by the listed score differential to unlock that game’s Crest. If you complete all 99 stars and all 33 Crests in a Domination, you’ll earn a reward worthy of its ultimate players.[/p][p][/p][p]Domination will launch with two sets this year representing the current NBA and the current WNBA leagues. As previously mentioned, WNBA Domination will need your lineup to be full of WNBA players to be eligible.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Player Card View[/b][/h3][p]Viewing, upgrading, or swapping your Player Cards has never looked so good in MyTEAM. When you click the right stick to view a card, it will expand into different layers that reveal attributes, Badges, Shoes, and Evolution requirements while the player is added to the menu replacing the photo cutout. This is your new one-stop-shop for editing your Player Cards.[/p][p][/p][p]This new Player Card view is also featured whenever you swap cards in a lineup. Improved attribute comparisons give you a quick way to compare strengths and weaknesses of different cards, along with both players on screen.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Favorite Cards in Your Collection[/b][/h3][p]Use the new Favorite feature to bookmark Player Cards and bring them to the forefront of your collection when swapping players. A new Autofill with Favorite Players has been added to quickly add these players to a new lineup, and they will be on display in the My Collection menu as well. [/p][p][/p][h3][i][b]Presentation Updates to Eras[/b][/i][/h3][p]Triple Threat and Clutch Time era games in Breakout and Challenges now have historic court floors to match the Eras filter and opponents for that game. Plus, some new screen filters have been added for a unique twist in Challenge games. Clutch Time across MyTEAM is also returning to a 14 second shot clock, based on community feedback.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/1a719f58fcb843a104ae9ba79f63f908ff428bf1.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Cinematic Walkout Reveals[/b][/h3][p]Still-frames are out and cinematic player walkout reveals are back, and now supporting two or more players walking out to celebrate together![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693118/110b655587a555540c962477fdc740ed7434abfb.gif"][/img][/p][h2][b]COMING UP NEXT[/b][/h2][p]Unite stars in MyTEAM this year with NBA and WNBA Player Cards. Collect players from both leagues and form never-before-seen lineup combinations. We can’t wait to see what the community comes up with—and we can’t wait to share what’s coming down the pipeline.[/p][p][/p][p]In case you missed, see what’s new in the [url="https://nba.2k.com/2k26/courtside-report/myplayer-builder/"]MyPLAYER Builder Courtside Report[/url], and keep an eye out for The W Courtside Report. [/p][p][/p][p]Get up to 7 days of Early Access*** when you [url="https://nba.2k.com/2k26/buy/"]pre-order[/url] the [i]Superstar[/i] or [i]Leave No Doubt Edition[/i], and receive additional bonus content![/p][p][/p][p][i]*Triple Threat Park, All-Star Team-Up, King of the Court, presented by AT&T, and MyTEAM Arena only available on NBA 2K26 for PC.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]**Open to legal residents of the 50 US & D.C. (excluding MD and CO), Australia, Canada (excluding Quebec), Chile, Denmark, Metropolitan France, Germany, Great Britain (England, Wales, and Scotland only), Greece, Greater China, Indonesia, Israel, Japan, Mexico, New Zealand, Norway, Philippines, Portugal, Republic of Ireland, Singapore, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Thailand, and Turkey, who are at least 18 and age of majority in their state/country/province of residence.
